code_or_recovery: Code from the app, or a recovery code
codes_explanation: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. Keep them somewhere safe: they're shown only now.

codes_left.@other: In the settings while two-factor authentication is on; {count} is how many unused recovery codes remain.

explanation_off: Off. Turn it on to sign in with a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
no_app: No authenticator app on this device opened the link. Enter the setup key there instead.
off_done: Two-factor authentication is off. Sign in again.
@off_done: On the login screen: turning it off signs the account out on every device, this one too.
off_explanation: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. Turning it off signs you out everywhere.
@open_in_app: Only on phones, where the QR code on the screen can't be scanned with the same phone.
renew_explanation: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes. The old recovery codes stop working.
setup_explanation: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key there. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
title: Two-factor authentication
